requirements.actor: VCF producer or consumer, as applicable to the stated operation
requirements.condition: When consuming the gVCF compatibility convention.
requirements.required_or_prohibited_behavior: Interpret <NON_REF> as the unspecified allele <*>.
requirements.observable_acceptance_condition: The two symbolic allele spellings resolve to the same unspecified-allele meaning.

requirements.title: Infer missing reference-block LEN from INFO END
requirements.atomic_statement: For backwards compatibility with gVCF, infer a missing FORMAT LEN value from INFO END when END is present.
requirements.actor: VCF producer or consumer, as applicable to the stated operation
requirements.condition: When FORMAT LEN is missing and INFO END is present in the reference-block representation.
requirements.required_or_prohibited_behavior: Use INFO END to infer the reference-block length.
requirements.observable_acceptance_condition: The inferred LEN corresponds to the END-defined reference-block length.

requirements.title: Base-modification reference-block values apply to all covered applicable bases

requirements.condition: When base-modification information is present in the FORMAT field of a reference-block record.

requirements.observable_acceptance_condition: Every applicable base covered by the block receives the block-level modification semantics.
